I assumed "evidence in some QTL dataset" means only a `test_evidence` row for AD, so I did not use `dataset_reliable`. I also treated the genes as independent, since each row is an independent event.

- It has four causal-SNP rows, each at 0.5, so P(some causal SNP) = 1 − 0.5⁴ = 0.9375.
- P(both) ≈ 0.97460 × 0.9375 ≈ 0.91369.

**PSMC6**
- It has two AD evidence rows, each at 0.0874, so P(some evidence) = 1 − 0.9126² ≈ 0.16716.
- It has two causal-SNP rows, each at 0.1, so P(some causal SNP) = 1 − 0.9² = 0.19.
- P(both) ≈ 0.16716 × 0.19 ≈ 0.03176.

**Combined**
P(at least one gene has both) = 1 − (1 − 0.91369)(1 − 0.03176) ≈ 1 − 0.08631 × 0.96824 ≈ 0.91643.
